source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design — Mandarin Grade 9 (Draft, First published 2024)
source.notes: Fetched via the easylearn.co.ke mirror (same pattern used for CRE/HRE/IRE) — WebFetch reported binary/unreadable content but saved the PDF locally, and Claude's Read tool parsed it natively. Structure verbatim from the PDF's SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS table and per-theme tables.

essenceNote: Kenya's foreign languages at Grade 9 are Mandarin, Arabic, French, and German — each a non-formal, basic (A1/YCT2-equivalent) 4-skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing) curriculum. Mandarin's design is structurally identical to French's and German's: same 3 strands, same 9 themes in the same order, confirmed directly against the PDF (not assumed from the shared essence statement alone).

notes: Same 9 themes repeat identically across all 3 strands, exactly mirroring French's and German's structure. Each strand teaches the theme's vocabulary through a different modality (LS = oral vocabulary/expression recall, R = short passage/dialogue + comprehension, W = spelling/gap-fill/word-order/descriptive writing). Per the standing 'never merge sub-strands' rule, this is 27 distinct skills (9 themes x 3 strands). Mandarin is distinctive among the four foreign languages in that its Listening & Speaking strand explicitly calls out 'pronunciation (Chinese tones)' as a named sub-strand focus (1.4), and its content is presented in hanzi (Chinese characters) with no romanization given by the curriculum itself — pinyin used in this project's skills is added for learnability/typing since the app has no Chinese IME. All example Mandarin words/phrases were pulled directly from the curriculum design's own suggested-learning-experiences tables (parenthetical 'e.g.' examples), e.g. 您好/早上好/下午好/您贵姓 (greetings), 叔叔/表哥/姑姑/堂妹/爸爸/妈妈 (family), 猫/狗/兔子/牛/羊/猪/狮子/豹子/斑马/大象 (animals), 起床/睡觉/做饭/做作业 (daily routine verbs), 打算/要/会/请 + 公园/商场/动物园 (fun/plans), 餐馆/菜单/点菜/买单/筷子/碗 (eating out), 头疼/发烧/咳嗽/胃痛 (health), 晴天/下雨/下雪/刮风 (weather), 东南西北/左/右/拐/转 (directions) — not invented independently.
